title: Seedance 2.0の「カット制作が優秀」な特性を活かし、生成動画から静止画（フレーム）を抜き出して編集素材として使う
content:
Seedance 2.0の「カット制作が優秀」な特性を活かし、生成動画から静止画（フレーム）を抜き出して編集素材として使う  
Seedance 2.0はアンドロイドバトルなどの「欠損（破損・欠落）表現」と相性が良いので、その表現を狙う場合はSeedance 2.0を選ぶ

en.content:
Make use of Seedance 2.0’s strength in “excellent cut editing” by extracting still images (frames) from generated videos and using them as editing素材.

Seedance 2.0 is also a good fit for “missing-part” expressions (damage, loss, or missing elements), such as android battles. If you want to aim for that kind of expression, choose Seedance 2.0.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
PR04
The opening sequence for a tokusatsu hero series I used to imagine as a child, writing out hundreds of pages of ideas. I made that dream come true. Seedance 2 is a great match for missing-part effects in android battles. I also created the lyrics and composition for the theme song by inputting a recording I made on a cassette tape into Suno.

es.content:
Aprovechando la característica de Seedance 2.0 de ser excelente en la “edición por cortes”, extrae imágenes fijas (frames) de los videos generados y úsalas como material de edición.  
Seedance 2.0 funciona especialmente bien con expresiones de “ausencia” (daños, partes faltantes, etc.), como en batallas de androides; si buscas ese tipo de efecto, elige Seedance 2.0.

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0의 “컷 제작이 뛰어나다”는 특성을 살려, 생성된 영상에서 정지 이미지(프레임)를 추출해 편집 소재로 활용한다.  
Seedance 2.0은 안드로이드 배틀 같은 “결손(파손·결락) 표현”과 궁합이 좋으므로, 그런 표현을 노릴 때는 Seedance 2.0을 선택한다.
